item.title: Lubbock County elections administrator offers tips for voters ahead of start of early voting
item.description: Early voting for the March primaries begins Tuesday February 17. Roxzine Stinson is the Lubbock County Elections Administrator and said planning ahead of your trip to the polls is key especially since the ballots are long.

item.title: Lady Raiders survive home scare from Kansas
item.description: No. 16 Texas Tech stepped back onto the court of United Supermarkets Arena on Tuesday for the first time since knocking off No. 17 TCU. The Lady Raiders were in another shootout against Kansas but were able to survive a home upset with a 70-65 win.

item.title: New Home mom tells journey of her son diagnosed with Type One Diabetes
item.description: Mason Ward, a six-year-old diagnosed with type one diabetes, and his parents are hoping that the Islet Act, which would classify pancreatic islet cells as an organ and allow insurance companies to cover the cost of a transplant, will be passed in the Senate 2025-2026 legislature.
